expectedBehavior: Both temporally active unmuted sources mix during the overlap with NO implicit crossfade/duck/ramp (ADR-012 §2). Incoming pre-boundary interval is silent; outgoing post-roll may continue (ADR-012 §1.0a items 5a/5b).

incoming.note: Incoming is silent during the pre-boundary hold; destination.start == B.

outgoing.note: Outgoing continues into the post-roll at normal speed (ADR-012 §1.0a item 5b).
